title: fleet-bus envelope v1
description: Wire envelope schema for the Artifice fleet-bus. Additive-only within v1: consumers MUST ignore unknown fields. Bump envelope_version to 2 only for breaking changes. See SPEC.md clause 1.

envelope_version.description: MUST be 1. On mismatch, consumers reject with `unsupported_envelope_version`.

id.description: Unique per publish. UUIDv4 recommended. Correlates with audit log.

from.description: Canonical fleet bot name — allowlist-checked against fleet-manifest.yaml bot_names. Not cryptographically bound to authenticated NATS user (see SPEC.md §4).

to.description: Direct recipient. Null or absent = broadcast (subject determines audience). Direct-request receivers reject on mismatch.

kind.description: Envelope semantic type. Standard: text_message, pr_review_request, pr_review_result, status_ping, status_heartbeat, baton.*. Unknown kinds are logged, not rejected.

in_reply_to.description: envelope.id of the message being answered. One hop back. For multi-hop trace, use baton root_id.

payload.description: Arbitrary JSON. Semantic per `kind`. Encoded envelope MUST fit within maxBytes (default 1_044_480).

root_id.description: Baton extension (v1.x additive) — chain identity, copied through descendants. Consumers without baton support MUST ignore per SPEC.md clause 1.

origin.description: Baton extension (v1.x additive) — bot that started the chain. Completion frames address `origin`, not up in_reply_to.

owner.description: Baton extension (v1.x additive) — current baton holder. Changes on baton.handoff.

hops.description: Baton extension (v1.x additive) — chain length counter. Warn at 8 (send warning to origin), reject at 16.
